name: Selective Burst
body:
Prerequisite(s): necroburst class feature, Intelligence 13.

Benefit(s): When you use your necroburst class feature, you may select any number of creatures, up to your Intelligence modifier. These creatures are not affected by your necroburst.

Normal: Necroburst affects all creatures within the area.
